about_short_description.short_description: Protex AI develops an AI-powered proactive health and safety technology that enables an injury-free industrial workplace.

product.name: Protex AI Proactive Safety Platform
product.description: An AI-powered computer vision platform that analyzes CCTV feeds to detect unsafe events, behaviors, and workplace hazards continuously.

product.name: Protex Intelligence
product.description: A generative AI assistant that converts safety and operational data into context-specific insights for EHS and operations teams.

product.name: Protex Predictive Analytics
product.description: Analytics capabilities that identify patterns and trends in safety data to help EHS teams anticipate workplace risks and prioritize interventions.

product.name: Protex Reporting & Workflows
product.description: Configurable dashboards and workflow tools for reviewing safety events, monitoring rules and cameras, generating reports, and managing corrective actions.

product.name: Protex Operations Analytics
product.description: Operational analytics for measuring area and asset utilization and identifying opportunities to improve facility efficiency and safety.

product.name: Protex Enterprise Integrations and Deployment
product.description: Enterprise deployment and integration services that connect Protex with existing CCTV, EHS management, and business intelligence systems.
